name: Software Development
description: Custom web applications and business software built around your requirements.
problem: Off-the-shelf tools rarely match how your team really works, so people end up with spreadsheets, workarounds and double entry.
solution: We design and build software around your actual workflow, then hand over something your team can run without a manual the size of a book.
features: Integrations with tools you already use
faqQuestion: Can you build on top of our existing system?
faqAnswer: Often yes. We review what you have first, then recommend whether to extend it or replace parts of it.

name: Website Development
description: Professional business websites designed to generate trust and leads.
problem: A dated or slow website quietly costs you enquiries. Visitors decide in seconds whether you look reliable.
solution: We build fast, clear websites that explain what you do, show how to reach you and are easy to update.
faqQuestion: Will I be able to edit the content myself?
faqAnswer: Yes. We agree upfront which parts you want to change yourself and structure the site accordingly.

name: CRM Development
description: Customer relationship platforms to manage leads, customers and sales.
problem: Leads arrive from calls, messages and forms, and follow-ups get forgotten because nothing is in one place.
solution: We build a CRM shaped around your sales steps, so every lead has an owner, a status and a next action.
faqQuestion: Is a custom CRM better than a ready-made one?
faqAnswer: It depends on how unusual your process is. If a standard tool fits, we will say so.

name: ERP Solutions
description: Connected business systems for managing operations, employees and resources.
problem: Inventory, accounts, HR and sales live in separate files, so nobody has a reliable view of the whole business.
solution: We connect those areas into one system, starting with the module that hurts most and adding the rest in stages.
faqQuestion: Do we need to switch everything at once?
faqAnswer: No. We usually roll out in phases so daily operations are not interrupted.

name: SaaS Development
description: Scalable cloud-based software products designed for recurring business use.
problem: Turning an idea into a subscription product needs accounts, billing logic and a structure that can grow.
solution: We help you scope a first version, build the multi-user foundation and prepare it to be improved after launch.
faqQuestion: Can you help define the MVP?
faqAnswer: Yes. We work with you to decide what the first release must include and what can wait.

name: AI Automation
description: Automate repetitive workflows and connect your business processes with AI.
problem: Staff spend hours copying data, sending the same messages and sorting requests by hand.
solution: We find the repetitive steps, automate the ones that are safe to automate and keep a person in control of the rest.
faqAnswer: The aim is to remove repetitive work so your team can spend time on customers.

name: UI/UX Design
description: Clean and practical interfaces designed for real users.
problem: Software that is hard to use gets ignored, no matter how many features it has.
solution: We study how your users complete tasks and design screens that make those tasks short and obvious.
faqQuestion: Can you redesign an existing product?
faqAnswer: Yes. We start by reviewing where users get stuck before changing visuals.

name: Maintenance & Support
description: Continuous improvements, maintenance and technical support.
problem: Software needs updates, fixes and small changes long after launch, and unmanaged systems slowly break.
solution: We stay available after delivery to fix issues, keep things updated and ship improvements.
faqQuestion: Do you support systems you did not build?
faqAnswer: In many cases yes, after a short review of the code and hosting.
